Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 12834 of 2023

Applicant :- Shiv Kumar
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Ajeet Kumar Srivastava

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Prakash Chandra Pathak
Hon'ble Prashant Kumar,J.
1.

Heard Shri Ajeet Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel for the applicant, Shri S.D. Pandey, learned A.G.A., representing the State, Shri P.C. Pathak, learned counsel appearing for opposite party no.2 and perused the record.

2. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant praying to direct the court below to accept the application under Section 217 CrPC of the applicant and stay the entire criminal proceeding of S.S.T. No. 01/2023 (State v. Shiv Kumar Saroj @ Bhuwal), arising out of Case Crime No. 278 of 2022, under Sections 376-AB IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act, Police Station- Mungrabadshahpur, District- Jaunpur and further direct the court below to recall the witnesses for the purpose of cross-examination as amended in the charge-sheet dated 03.01.2023 by the order dated 22.03.2023.
3.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that in the instant case the opposite party no.2 lodged an F.I.R. on 26-11-2022 against unknown person for the offences under Section 376 IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.

It is further submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the Shiv Kumar vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100745484/

sentences.text: Investigating Officer without carrying proper investigation has submitted charge-sheet and the learned court below framed the charge against the applicant under Section 376AB IPC and 5M/6 of POCSO Act and thereafter the trial commenced and the witnesses were being examined in the trial court

. Further submission is that the Special Prosecutor had filed an application dated 09-03-2023 to amend the charge dated 03-01-2023 as the incident is of 25-11-2022 instead of 26-11-2022 and the learned trial court by its order dated 22-03-2023 has allowed the application dated 09-03-2023 and amend the charge.

It is further submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant filed an application under Section 217 Cr.P.C. for recalling the witness those who have already been examined and cross-examined before alteration of the charge but the learned trial court did not accept the application under Section 217 Cr.P.C., which the applicant has prayed to direct the learned trial court to accept the said application.
4.

Sri Shashi Dhar Pandey, learned A.G.A. has filed a counter affidavit and in para 6 of the affidavit it has been stated that it is absolutely wrong to say that the Special Public Prosecutor had moved any application to amend in framing of charge dated 03-01-2023, although a correction application was moved for correction of the date of incident as 25-11-2022 instead of 26-11-2022 and the learned trial court vide order dated 22-03-2023 corrected the date of the incident as 25-11-2022 instead of 26-11-2022.
It is further submitted that the charges has not been amended at all as stated by the learned counsel for the applicant.

It is further stated in the counter affidavit that the applicant has misinterpreted the Section 217 Cr.P.C. and the court below has rightly rejected his application as the charges were not amended by the learned trial court and only correction in the date of incident has been done, therefore, question for recalling the witnesses and cross-examination does not arise.
5.

Having considered the rival submissions of both the parties and after perusing the record, I am of the view that the court below has rightly rejected the application of the applicant under Section 217 Cr.P.C. as there is no amendment in framing of charge and there is only correction in the date of incident as 25-11-2022 instead of 26-11-2022.
The instant application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. has no merit and is accordingly dismissed.

Order Date :- 15.2.2024 Rama Kant  Shiv Kumar vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100745484/
